    size_scaled = float(np.sum(np.abs(scaled)))
    if not np.all(np.isfinite([defect_scaled, size_scaled])):
        raise ValueError("縮放後的相容性加總不是有限值")

    # |defect_scaled| 不超過 size_scaled，故可將門檻安全地截於此值。

    if tolerances[1] >= 1.0 or scale <= tolerances[0] / size_scaled:
        threshold_scaled = size_scaled
    else:
        relative_part = float(tolerances[1] * size_scaled)
        absolute_part = float(tolerances[0] / scale)
        room = size_scaled - relative_part
        threshold_scaled = (size_scaled if absolute_part >= room
                            else relative_part + absolute_part)
    if abs(defect_scaled) > threshold_scaled:
        raise ValueError(
            "純 Neumann 右端不相容："
            f"scaled defect={defect_scaled}, scaled tolerance={threshold_scaled}"
        )
    # 回傳經截頂的縮放門檻；它用於判定，不是原單位的容差。
